name: Template: Simple Kanban
description: General-purpose kanban board for engineering teams. Each swimlane represents a team or workstream.

swimlanes.name: Frontend
swimlanes.notes: React / TypeScript. Owns all UI components, pages, and the design system.

swimlanes.name: Backend
swimlanes.notes: Django / Python. Owns API, models, background tasks, and WebSocket layer.

swimlanes.name: DevOps
swimlanes.notes: Owns CI/CD, Docker, Helm, infrastructure, and deployment pipelines.

swimlanes.name: QA
swimlanes.notes: Owns test strategy, Playwright E2E suite, and release sign-off.

cards.title: Accessibility audit: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
cards.description:
Run a full WCAG 2.1 AA audit on the board view and card detail. Use axe-core and manual keyboard navigation testing.

File individual issues for each violation found.

cards.title: Fix focus trap in dropdown menus
cards.description:
Tab key escapes the dropdown menu when it reaches the last item. Should cycle back to the first item.

Affects: FilterBar, SelectDropdown, column header menu.

cards.title: Redesign card detail modal layout
cards.description:
The card detail modal is crowded on smaller screens. Proposed layout:

- Move assignee + due date to a sidebar
- Give description full-width space
- Collapse checklist by default

cards.title: Keyboard shortcut N to open quick-add card
cards.description:
Pressing `N` (when no input is focused) should open a quick-add modal pre-scoped to the last focused column/swimlane cell.

Implementation:
- Listen for `keydown` on `BoardView`
- Track last focused cell in a ref
- Open `CreateCardModal` with column + swimlane pre-filled

checklist.text: Track last focused cell in ref
Test: N does nothing when input focused

cards.title: Dark mode flicker on page load
cards.description:
When the OS is in dark mode, there is a brief white flash before the dark theme is applied. Caused by: theme class applied after first paint.

Fix: inline theme script in `<head>` before `<body>` renders.

checklist.text: Add inline theme detection script to index.html
Verify no flash on cold load

comments.body: Inline script added. Testing in progress.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Email notification Celery worker
cards.description:
Build the Celery task that sends email notifications for:

- Card assigned to me
- @mention in comment
- Due date approaching (< 24h)

Idempotent: skip if notification already sent today.

checklist.text: Test with real SMTP in staging

cards.title: Refactor card move endpoint to use a serializer
cards.description:
The `POST /api/cards/{id}/move/` view contains too much business logic. Move validation and WIP check logic into a `CardMoveSerializer`.

This makes the logic unit-testable and removes the view's fat.

cards.title: Rate limiting on authentication endpoints
cards.description:
Add per-IP and per-user rate limiting to `POST /api/auth/login/` and `POST /api/auth/token/refresh/`.

Use `django-ratelimit`. Limits: 10 req/min per IP, 5 req/min per user.

checklist.text: Add integration tests for limit exceeded (429)

comments.body: Login endpoint rate-limited. Refresh endpoint next.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: N+1 query in BoardFullSerializer.get_members()
cards.description:
Loading `/api/boards/{id}/full/` issues one query per member to resolve inherited group roles. On a 15-member board this is 15 extra queries.

Fix: add `prefetch_related('memberships__user__groups')` to the viewset queryset.

checklist.text: Profile with django-silk to confirm N+1

comments.body: Confirmed: 15 extra queries on a 15-member board.
comments.author: demo1

comments.body: prefetch_related added — down to 4 total queries. Benchmarking.
comments.author: demo2

cards.title: Audit log pagination (cursor-based)
cards.description:
The `GET /api/boards/{id}/movements/` endpoint returns all records without pagination. On active boards this can be 10,000+ records.

Implement cursor-based pagination using `created_at` as the cursor.

checklist.text: Update frontend to use cursor token

comments.body: Done. Frontend updated to load-more pattern.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Postgres upgrade from 14 to 16
cards.description:
Postgres 14 reaches EOL in November 2026. Plan and execute upgrade:

1. Test on staging with pg_upgrade
2. Verify all queries still work
3. Coordinate downtime window with team
4. Upgrade production

checklist.text: Test pg_upgrade on staging DB dump
Run full test suite on PG16

cards.title: Staging environment auto-refresh on main merge
cards.description:
Staging should automatically deploy the latest `main` branch on every merge. Currently requires a manual trigger.

Add a GitLab CI deploy stage targeting `staging` environment.

checklist.text: Add staging deploy job to CI
Test auto-deploy on a test merge

cards.title: Reduce Docker image size (current: 1.2 GB)
cards.description:
The production Docker image is 1.2 GB. Target: < 400 MB.

Quick wins:
- Multi-stage build (separate build and runtime stages)
- Use `python:3.12-slim` as base
- Remove dev dependencies from final image

cards.title: Add readiness probe to Helm chart
cards.description:
The Django service has no readiness probe — Kubernetes routes traffic to pods before migrations have finished running.

Add an HTTP readiness probe on `/api/health/` that returns 200 only when migrations are complete.

checklist.text: Wire migration check into health endpoint

comments.body: Health endpoint done. Helm chart update in PR.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Add Bandit security scan to CI pipeline
cards.description:
Run `bandit -r backend/` on every MR. Fail the pipeline on HIGH severity findings.

Add to `.gitlab-ci.yml` as a new `security` stage job.

comments.body: Bandit added. 2 HIGH findings fixed (shell=True, hardcoded secret in test).
comments.author: demo1

cards.description:

| iPhone 15 | Safari |

cards.title: Regression suite for v1.1 release
cards.description:
Build a regression test suite covering the core flows changed in v1.1:

- Card create / edit / delete
- Swimlane reorder
- Label management
- Board member invite

Target: 20 tests, all passing before v1.1 ships.

cards.title: E2E test: card drag and drop across columns
cards.description:
Write a Playwright E2E test covering:

1. Drag card from column A to column B
2. Verify card appears in column B
3. Verify CardMovement record is created
4. Verify WIP count updates in column headers

comments.body: Happy path done. WIP limit test in progress.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Load test: 100 concurrent users on board view
cards.description:
Run a Locust load test simulating 100 concurrent users loading the board view. Acceptance criteria:

- p95 response time < 800ms
- No 5xx errors under load
- Memory usage < 512MB per worker

checklist.text: Write Locust scenario for board load

comments.body: p95: 650ms. No 5xx. Memory OK. Writing up results.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Fix flaky Playwright test #148 (swimlane reorder)
cards.description:
Test #148 fails intermittently (~1 in 8 runs) because it clicks the drag handle before the animation from the previous test completes.

Fix: add `await page.waitForSelector('.drag-handle:visible')` before the drag.

checklist.text: Run test 20 times to confirm stability
